nested.inherited: An item is eligible only when its donor is identified and the archive rights registrar signed the deposit release.
clauses: named donor is present in accession register
archive rights registrar signed deposit release
team-specific rights attachment matches the recording

oral_history.rule: For oral-history recordings, require a speaker release naming the exact recording revision.
oral_history.good: Speaker release SR-{n} signed by {person}, the recorded speaker, names recording revision {rev}.
oral_history.bad: Speaker release SR-{n} does not name recording revision {rev}.

field_recording.rule: For field recordings, require the location consent to cover the named site.
field_recording.good: Location consent LC-{n} explicitly covers site {site}.
field_recording.bad: Location consent LC-{n} covers a different site, not {site}.

nested.inherited: A repair is dispatchable only when the stop is on the active register and the network maintenance lead approved the work order.
clauses: maintenance lead approved the work order
local accessibility evidence meets the stop type rule

platform.rule: For platform work, require a tactile-strip inspection for the current platform section.
platform.good: Inspection TI-{n} covers the tactile strip on platform section {site}.
platform.bad: Inspection TI-{n} covers an older section, not the tactile strip on {site}.

vehicle.rule: For vehicle boarding work, require the ramp test to name the assigned vehicle.
vehicle.good: Ramp test RT-{n} passed on assigned vehicle {vehicle}.
vehicle.bad: Ramp test RT-{n} names a different vehicle, not assigned vehicle {vehicle}.

nested.inherited: A dispatch is eligible only when a named donor supplied the batch and the cooperative food-safety steward approved its release.
clauses: local handling note supports this delivery class

cultures.rule: For live cultures, require the batch card to specify sealed chilled transport.
cultures.good: Batch card BC-{n} specifies sealed chilled transport for {thing}.
cultures.bad: Batch card BC-{n} permits ambient transport for {thing}.

produce.rule: For produce crates, require the recipient's wash station to be confirmed.
produce.good: Recipient {site} confirmed wash station WS-{n} for this crate.
produce.bad: Recipient {site} has not confirmed wash station WS-{n} for this crate.

nested.inherited: A visit is eligible only when the research team is named on the seasonal roster and the site custodian approved the date window.
clauses: research team is named on seasonal roster
site custodian approved this date window

wetland.rule: For wetland work, require the active reed-nest buffer to be carried into the visit plan.
wetland.good: Plan {n} carries the active reed-nest buffer at {site}.
wetland.bad: Plan {n} omits the active reed-nest buffer at {site}.

cliff.rule: For cliff work, require a local ranger to accept the rope-access plan.
cliff.good: Local ranger {person}, assigned to {site}, accepted rope-access plan RA-{n} for {site}.
cliff.bad: Rope-access plan RA-{n} has no acceptance from a local ranger for {site}.

nested.inherited: A translation is eligible only when the source edition is identified and the rights editor approved this release.

Kalo.rule: For Kalo editions, require a second-reader note confirming the agreed glossary terms.
Kalo.good: Second-reader note K-{n} confirms the agreed glossary for {thing}.
Kalo.bad: Second-reader note K-{n} flags an unresolved glossary term in {thing}.

Ruma.rule: For Ruma editions, require the community reviewer to approve the register choice.
Ruma.good: Community reviewer {person} approved the register choice for {thing}.
Ruma.bad: Community reviewer {person} has not approved the register choice for {thing}.

nested.inherited: A repair is eligible only when the member is identified on the work slip and the workshop custodian signed the repair authorization.
clauses: member is named on work slip
craft-specific material and safety check is satisfied

woodshop.rule: For woodshop repairs, require the grain-match note to identify the replacement piece.
woodshop.good: Grain note GN-{n} matches replacement piece {thing}.
woodshop.bad: Grain note GN-{n} does not match replacement piece {thing}.

textile.rule: For textile repairs, require the dye-lot card to confirm colorfast thread.
textile.good: Dye-lot card DL-{n} confirms colorfast thread for {thing}.
textile.bad: Dye-lot card DL-{n} does not confirm colorfast thread for {thing}.

nested.inherited: A clip is eligible only when the narrator is identified and the library archivist signed the public-use release.

web_audio.rule: For web audio, require the transcript and clip timestamps to agree.
web_audio.good: Transcript TR-{n} aligns with clip timestamps for {thing}.
web_audio.bad: Transcript TR-{n} has timestamps that do not align with {thing}.

exhibit.rule: For exhibit clips, require the visitor display caption to use the approved name form.
exhibit.good: Caption CP-{n} uses the approved name form for {person}.
exhibit.bad: Caption CP-{n} uses a name form not approved for {person}.

nested.domain: watershed sampling permission and safety review
nested.inherited: A sample is eligible only when its monitoring station is on the seasonal plan and the watershed steward approved collection.

upper_basin.rule: For upper-basin samples, require the steep-bank tether check.
upper_basin.good: Steep-bank tether check TC-{n} is complete at steep {site}.
upper_basin.bad: Steep-bank tether check TC-{n} is absent at steep {site}.

lower_basin.rule: For lower-basin samples, require the public-path notice to be posted.
lower_basin.good: Notice PN-{n} is posted at public path {site}.
lower_basin.bad: Notice PN-{n} is not posted at public path {site}.

nested.inherited: A retrofit is eligible only when the building association is identified and the grant officer approved the match plan.

heat_pump.rule: For heat-pump work, require a load calculation for the current building envelope.
heat_pump.good: Load sheet LS-{n} uses the current envelope for {thing}.
heat_pump.bad: Load sheet LS-{n} uses the prior envelope for {thing}.

solar.rule: For rooftop solar, require a roof engineer's signed capacity note.
solar.good: Roof engineer {person} signed roof capacity note RC-{n} for {thing} at {site}.
solar.bad: Roof capacity note RC-{n} is unsigned for {thing}.

nested.inherited: A trip is eligible only when the class is named on the term calendar and the principal approved the excursion window.

wheelchair_route.rule: For wheelchair routes, require a step-free route confirmation for the named venue entrance.
wheelchair_route.good: Venue {site} confirmed step-free entrance route SR-{n}.
wheelchair_route.bad: Venue {site} has not confirmed step-free route SR-{n}.

sensory_plan.rule: For sensory plans, require a quiet-room contact to be assigned for the visit.
sensory_plan.good: Quiet-room contact {person} is assigned for visit {n}.
sensory_plan.bad: No quiet-room contact is assigned for visit {n}.

nested.inherited: A roster assignment is eligible only when the interpreter is named for the session and the clinic language lead approved the roster entry.
clauses: clinic language lead approved roster entry

Kalo.rule: For Kalo sessions, require current B2-or-higher proficiency and active confidentiality training. The roster proficiency scale is C1 above B2 above B1.
Kalo.good: Roster shows {person} has current CEFR C1 Kalo proficiency through {site} and active confidentiality training through {site}.
Kalo.bad: Roster shows {person} has current CEFR B1 Kalo proficiency, below B2, and active confidentiality training through {site}.

Ruma.rule: For Ruma sessions, require current B2-or-higher proficiency and active confidentiality training. The roster proficiency scale is C1 above B2 above B1.
Ruma.good: Roster shows {person} has current CEFR B2 Ruma proficiency through {site} and active confidentiality training through {site}.
Ruma.bad: Roster shows {person} has current CEFR B2 Ruma proficiency through {site}, but confidentiality training expired before {site}.

nested.inherited: A tree-care visit is eligible only when the block association is named and the urban forestry coordinator approved the work window.
clauses: urban forestry coordinator approved work window

nesting_tree.rule: For trees with active nests, require a buffer plan accepted by the wildlife monitor.
nesting_tree.good: Wildlife monitor {person} accepted buffer plan BP-{n} for active nest at {thing} {n}.
nesting_tree.bad: Buffer plan BP-{n} has no wildlife monitor acceptance for active nest at {thing} {n}.

street_tree.rule: For street trees, require utility clearance for the exact planting bay.
street_tree.good: Utility ticket UT-{n} clears the exact planting bay {site}.
street_tree.bad: Utility ticket UT-{n} clears a different bay, not {site}.
